tests.case: renders a thin shelf as complete and places its own count beside the desktop heading

FeedViewModelTests.A_thin_shelf_is_a_fin.reason: A three-card shelf renders its actual count beside the desktop heading without a loading state or vacant card placeholders.

tests.case: retains both verdict attempts and the revocation stamp after dismiss, Undo and dismiss again

FeedFeedbackTests.Dismissing_again_after.reason: Both surfaces render the two attempts, the earlier revocation date and exactly one available Undo.

tests.case: a thrown verdict failure becomes a retryable card error without claiming a saved receipt

FeedFeedbackTests.A_service_that_throws_.reason: A rejected write produces a card error with no saved receipt; retry saves the intended verdict and clears the error.

tests.case: states the history count only after responses exist and stays quiet for recent play alone

FeedFeedbackTests.The_header_states_the_.reason: Desktop and fullscreen avoid empty history counts and scoring claims for the unscored recent-play shelf; the history count updates after a saved response.
